author: Mark Atwood
text:
Escalating: free-function vs builder-struct is a foundational API-shape decision and wants explicit human direction. Engineering basis recap:

Arguments for the current free-function shape:
- Simple bytes-in/anchors-out crate; the README sells this explicitly ('small Tier 1 building block').
- Recent additions (from_pem_file_with_cap / from_der_file_with_cap from PKIX-tit4.24) extended the surface via new function names rather than options — the maintainer has implicitly chosen 'new name per option' once already.
- Adapter crates (pkix-truststore-system / pkix-truststore-pkcs11) are also free-function shaped, suggesting workspace convention is functions-not-builders for Tier-1 plumbing.

Arguments for moving to a Loader struct:
- The README explicitly says 'Per-anchor trust policy is out of scope for now; revisit when a concrete consumer asks for it.' That foreshadows options that don't fit free-function shape.
- AGENTS.md prelaunch framing rejects 'no consumer demand' as a stay-current argument: 'wait for consumer demand to drive the API' is exactly the wrong-frame reasoning to avoid.
- The bead enumerates 5 future options (strict NC — now shipped; per-anchor filter; warning channel; load-time validity-period filter; mmap/chunked). At least 2 (filter, warning channel) cannot reasonably be free-function args.
- 'from_pem_strict_with_filter_with_warnings' is the worst-case outcome of staying with the current pattern.

Recommendation if no human pushback within 24h: stay at free-function with the documented escape-hatch precedent (_with_cap). Engineering basis: (1) the only options likely to land in 1.0 are strict-mode (already shipped non-optionally via PKIX-tit4.1), cap (shipped as _with_cap), and per-anchor filter (not in scope per README). (2) Future builder-shaped options can be added under a new Loader struct alongside the free functions when concrete demand surfaces; the migration cost is small because adapter crates pre-collect DER bytes and call from_der_iter, so an alternate Loader API doesn't disrupt them. (3) Workspace-wide consistency: the from_pem / from_der / etc. naming is now used by 3+ crates (pkix-truststore, pkix-aia-http, pkix-revocation-http loader entry points). Reversing it here without reversing it across the workspace fragments the convention.

Counter-recommendation: if the maintainer's instinct is 'we WILL grow per-anchor options before 1.0,' add a LoaderOptions builder pattern alongside the free functions now. The free functions become Loader::default().from_pem(...) shorthand. Pre-1.0 breaking-change cost is zero.
